why: Argo v3 is built route by route as the sibling app on the same API. G4.
what: The usage explore tab: lists, split, scope, budget, routing and athena sections, change badge, pick options, model, types and the usage query. Mounts the quota parts (v3-argo-route-usage-quotas). No route file.
must_not_touch: apps/dashboard/**, apps/api/**, packages/shared/**, .basalt/**, apps/dashboard-v3/package.json and bun.lock (v3-argo-bump-g3/g4), other Issues' dirs under apps/dashboard-v3/src

usage-tracking/{accounts*,flow-node*} (state-features, state-stores) and the quota parts {quotas,quota-chart,over-time,drain,heat,pace,period,rhythm,weekly-volume,verdict-band}* (v3-argo-route-usage-quotas), all under apps/dashboard-v3/src/features/
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.1-6.3, argo DESIGN.md and the managed layer (.claude/rules/basalt-v3-*.md, skills basalt-v3-*). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-argo-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Never import apps/dashboard; share through @argo/shared. *.module.css files are not ported (classes replace them). This feature's model.ts, types.ts and tests are ported here.
exemplar: Follow apps/dashboard-v3/src/routes/__root.tsx, then the nearest landed route port, and the catalogue in .claude/skills/basalt-v3-design.
change: Port the explore view: explore-tab, explore-lists and split-lists on BarList or DataTable, split, scope, budget, routing-section, athena-section, change-badge, pick-options with their models and tests, and lib/queries/usage (`unwrap` from basalt-ui/data); mount the quota parts. model.ts and types.ts are ported here (the flow Issue imports them). Categorical colour follows ledger rows 232-233. No route file: the flow Issue owns usage-tracking.tsx. Rule: the app preset passes without new waivers. Skill snippet: none; recipes: the installed docs/recipes.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make design-shot APP=dashboard-v3 ROUTES="/usage-tracking?view=explore"` (1440x900, 390x844) beside the old route's shots from APP=dashboard; basalt-design reviewer on the board; density equal or better; at most 3 rounds.
acceptance: `make check` exits 0 (runs check-v3: sync --check, doctor, lint, typecheck, build, test)

`bun scripts/check-test-port.ts apps/dashboard/src/features/usage-tracking apps/dashboard-v3/src/features/usage-tracking --only '{explore,split,scope,budget,change-badge,pick-options,athena-section,routing-section,model,types}*'` exits 0 and `bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test src/features/usage-tracking` passes (changed lines carry `// port: <reason>` markers, listed in the PR)

a test over the series each explore chart draws in dark mode asserts every pair in one chart is at least 0.10 apart in OKLab distance (the owner-rejected pair #38bdf8 and #7dd3fc measures 0.083; ledger rows 232-233)
out_of_scope: Other routes, state and shell code, API changes.
